title: My Ultramarine Sky
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kai and Ren have shared a class and neighboring desks since middle school, until their last year of high school splits them up. Feeling Ren drift away, Kai whispers his feelings to a sleeping Ren, who hears him. A single-volume boys' love drama about friends deciding what their bond is.
life_message: Saying what you feel, even awkwardly, is better than letting a close friendship fade in silence.

content.note: Anxiety over losing a friend; no frightening content.
